cq_coverage.details: All competency questions are fully supported. The ontology provides explicit classes and properties for invoices, organizations, roles, items, prices, identifiers, business processes, and validation, with clear structural mapping to EDIFACT and regulatory requirements. No CQ is left unaddressed.

issues: Some object properties (e.g., :hasOrganizationPlayingRole) still lack rdfs:label and rdfs:comment
All datatype properties now use OWL 2 compliant datatypes (xsd:string, xsd:decimal), but :hasDate remains xsd:string instead of xsd:dateTime

strengths: Deep, well-structured hierarchy for EDIFACT, invoice, and business concepts
Comprehensive use of restrictions for mandatory structure
weaknesses: No General Class Axioms (GCAs) for inferred groupings
Some technical classes (e.g., Segment, Data Element, Delimiter) could be further disjointed

likely_oops_pitfalls: P4: Missing annotations for some properties

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add rdfs:label and rdfs:comment annotations to all object and data properties, especially those missing (e.g., :hasOrganizationPlayingRole, :isOrganizationPlayingRole).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves documentation and reduces OOPS pitfalls, especially P4.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce General Class Axioms for inferred groupings, e.g., define a 'ValidInvoice' class using GCAs based on mandatory fields and validation constraints.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables richer reasoning and validation scenarios.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand disjointness axioms to cover additional technical classes (e.g., Segment, CompositeDataElement, SimpleDataElement, Delimiter).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Prevents unintended class overlaps and improves model clarity.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Model EDIFACT code lists and value sets for segments and data elements as individuals or SKOS concepts.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Supports code mapping and enhances technical completeness.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Change :hasDate property range from xsd:string to xsd:dateTime for semantic precision.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves data validation and semantic accuracy.

summary: The ontology now fully supports all competency questions and has resolved previous critical OWL 2 compliance issues. Quality has improved with deeper hierarchy and expanded disjointness axioms. However, some object properties remain without proper annotations, and General Class Axioms are still absent. Further annotation and axiomatization work will bring the ontology to full best-practice compliance.

suggestions_addressed: Change all xsd:date datatype properties to xsd:dateTime to ensure OWL 2 DL compliance (partially: no xsd:date, but :hasDate is still xsd:string)
Expand disjointness axioms to cover additional technical and business classes (partially: some new disjointness, but not exhaustive)
suggestions_ignored: Add rdfs:label and rdfs:comment annotations to all object and data properties (several remain missing)
Introduce General Class Axioms for inferred groupings
Model EDIFACT code lists and value sets for segments and data elements
improvement_tracking.notes: Major compliance issues were resolved and disjointness improved, but annotation completeness and advanced axiomatization remain to be addressed for best-practice quality.
